units.source_text: 夕雾现已可应大学寮考试了。

en.t: Yugiri was now ready to take the examination at the Bureau of Education.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣先叫他到自己跟前来预试一下。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, first called him before him to give him a preliminary test.

units.source_text: 照例召请右大将、左大弁、式部大辅及左中弁等人来监试。

en.t: As usual, he invited the Right Captain, the Senior Controller of the Left, the Assistant Minister of Ceremonial, the Middle Controller of the Left, and others to oversee the examination.

units.source_text: 又请出那位师傅大内记来，叫他指出《史记》较困难的各卷中考试时儒学博士可能提到的各节来，

en.t: He also summoned the tutor, the Senior Secretary, and had him point out the passages from the more difficult chapters of the Records of the Historian that the Confucian scholars might raise in the examination,

units.source_text: 令夕雾通读一遍。

en.t: then made Yugiri read through them all once.

units.source_text: 但见他朗声诵读，毫无阻滞，各节义理，融会贯通，所有难解之处，无不了如指掌。

en.t: Yugiri recited in a clear voice without the slightest hesitation, grasping the meaning of every passage and understanding every difficult point perfectly.

units.source_text: 其明慧实甚可惊。

en.t: His intelligence was truly astonishing.

units.source_text: 监试诸人，都赞叹他的天才，大家感动流泪。

en.t: All those supervising the test praised his talent, and everyone was moved to tears.

units.source_text: 尤其是他的大母舅右中将，他叹息道：“太政大臣若在世间，该是何等欢喜啊！”

en.t: In particular, his great-uncle, the Middle Captain of the Right, sighed and said, "If the Chancellor were still alive, how delighted he would be!"

units.source_text: 说着，哭泣起来。

en.t: With that, he began to weep.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣也情不自禁，叹道：“儿子日渐长大，父母随之而日渐愚痴，此乃世之常态。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, could not restrain himself either and sighed, "As children grow day by day, their parents grow foolish along with them; such is the way of the world.

units.source_text: 我等旁观他人如此演变，但觉可笑，不料自己年龄还不很老，也就如此了。”

en.t: When we watched others change like this, we only found it amusing, yet before I have even grown very old, I have become the same way myself."

units.source_text: 说着也举手拭泪。

en.t: As he spoke, he too raised his hand to wipe away his tears.

units.source_text: 师傅大内记见此光景，以为自己教导有方，心中不胜欢喜，自觉面目光彩。

en.t: Seeing this, the tutor, the Senior Secretary, felt that his teaching had been effective, was overjoyed, and felt greatly honored.

units.source_text: 右大将便敬他一杯酒。

en.t: The Right Captain then offered him a cup of wine.

units.source_text: 大内记喝得很醉，脸色十分黄瘦。

en.t: The Senior Secretary became very drunk, his face looking sallow and thin.

units.source_text: 这大内记脾气古怪，学识渊博，而怀才不遇，孤苦贫困。

en.t: This Senior Secretary was eccentric in temperament and deeply learned, but his talents had gone unrecognized, and he lived lonely and poor.

units.source_text: 源氏赏识他的才学，特聘他为西席。

en.t: Genji valued his learning and talent and specially engaged him as Yugiri's tutor.

units.source_text: 他身受过分的优遇，似觉源氏内大臣的恩德使他脱胎换骨了。

en.t: Receiving such extraordinary favor, he seemed to feel that the Inner Minister Genji's kindness had remade him completely.

units.source_text: 况且将来夕雾发迹，他还可受到无上的信任呢。

en.t: Moreover, when Yugiri rose in the world in the future, he could expect to receive the highest trust as well.
